title: UI-V2 — owner-first experience: VN-first shell (Tổng quan/Mục tiêu/Công việc/Phê duyệt/Nhân sự AI + Nâng cao), governed NL intake (/api/v1/intake/draft advisory seam + Intake page + canonical objective commit), owner cockpit Home, ObjectiveDetail owner tabs, dark-navy theme
description: Owner-first V2 UX on base ab0fccf. NEW governed NL intake: POST /api/v1/intake/draft returns a bounded deterministic draft + advisory semantic evidence (mode off/shadow/guarded; plannerRunId:null → evidence NEVER pinned to a run; provider failure degrades to typed unavailable + manual draft). Intake commits ONLY through canonical seams — objective → POST /api/vnext/objectives (dedup_key, existing service); mission → /app/missions/new?goal= prefill (existing preview/confirm). Model prose never self-authorizes: provenance tags per field (từ văn bản/AI đề xuất/chưa có/bạn đã sửa), explicit owner confirm, business required for objectives. Shell: owner-first VN nav + advanced Nâng cao disclosure (all legacy /app/* routes preserved), Owner/Advanced presentation toggle over the SAME authority, dark-navy + light theme, mobile rail/bottom-tabs/drawer. Home cockpit reads canonical aggregates only (objectives/missions/approvals/operations rollup) — honest —/… states, zero fabrication. ObjectiveDetail wraps existing canonical sections in owner tabs (Tổng quan/Kế hoạch/Thực thi/Kết quả/Nâng cao) via ?tab= deep links — legacy content fully reachable under Nâng cao. No P18.x behavior weakened: semantic modes unchanged, preview/confirm gates unchanged, fail-closed preserved. E2E: ui-v2.spec.ts (9 tests: intake draft/edit/confirm→canonical objective, mission handoff, fail-closed no-business + analyze-401, tabs, mobile 390×844, themes, keyboard); legacy specs reconciled to the V2 nav. Baseline: interpretation advisory only; OFF default; no auto-merge.
